title: rosa villosa subsp. alpicola
intro: Rosa villosa subsp. alpicola, commonly known as the alpine sweet rose or alpine wild rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa villosa species, a type of wild rose plant native to the mountainous regions of the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa villosa subsp. alpicola are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
